# JOB POSTING TEMPLATE

## Status

IS AI-GENERATED: YES (Codex-assisted draft)
REVIEWED: yes (12AM:40 31/05/2026 - Khoi Minh Nguyen)

---

## Purpose

This document defines the template for one Requirement 1 QA/QC job posting analysis.

Goals:

* Capture all required job-posting details
* Preserve source and screenshot evidence
* Identify AI/LLM/automation-AI relevance
* Support final report summary tables
* Keep each job posting traceable as `JOB-XXX`

---

## File Naming Format

```text
JOB-XXX_<platform>_<role>.md
```

Example:

```text
JOB-001_linkedin_qa_automation_engineer.md
```

---

## 1. Metadata

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Job ID | JOB-XXX |
| Platform | LinkedIn / Indeed / Company site / Other |
| Company |  |
| Role title |  |
| Location |  |
| Work mode | On-site / Hybrid / Remote |
| Date posted | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Date captured | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Published within 60 days | yes/no |
| AI-related role | yes/no |
| Status | DRAFT / REVIEWED / VERIFIED / FINAL |

---

## 2. Source And Evidence

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Job URL |  |
| Screenshot evidence ID | EV-XXX |
| Screenshot path |  |
| Screenshot shows account name | yes/no |
| Salary evidence | Listed / Not listed / Separate source |

---

## 3. Job Description

```text
Summarize the job description in your own words. Do not fabricate missing details.
```

---

## 4. Required Skills

| Skill | Category | Evidence from posting |
| --- | --- | --- |
|  | Manual testing / Automation / API / Performance / AI / Soft skill |  |

---

## 5. Salary And Benefits

```text
Record salary if available. If missing, write "Not listed in posting" and do not invent a number.
```

---

## 6. AI Impact Analysis

Write the required AI impact analysis for this job posting.

Checklist:

* [ ] Explains what AI can replace
* [ ] Explains what AI can assist
* [ ] Explains what AI cannot replace
* [ ] Mentions role-specific tools or tasks where relevant
* [ ] Uses evidence from the posting
* [ ] Avoids generic claims

```text
AI impact analysis:
```

---

## 7. Verification Notes

```text
What was manually checked?
What might be uncertain?
What should be rechecked before final submission?
```

---

## Final Notes

Every job posting must be supported by a dated screenshot with the account/login name visible. The screenshot is anti-cheat evidence, so it should be captured and stored before the posting changes or disappears.
